limits: Shared managers are retained per process (one entry per distinct endpoint/client/secret/TLS fingerprint); tokens refresh in place. No eviction: entries are ~KB and real deployments use ~1 credential set.
Secrets enter the share key only as SHA-256; the key is never logged. Debug/redaction impls unchanged (credential_redact green).

A revoked-but-unexpired token is now reused until the manager refreshes (previously every open refetched); failure semantics otherwise unchanged, and the manager path already had these semantics via authenticate_with_token_provider.

Cell driver was a scratch example (raw BrokerConn opens, deleted after); committed coverage is the in-process coalescing test. Absolute ms is host/broker-specific; the fetch-count outcome is structural.
